children: Australia's economy appears to be getting a stall warning, with two indicators of consumer confidence Tuesday showing the mood among households has turned sour. Business conditions were negative for the first time since the pandemic--a sign the economy is starting to stall amid talk of higher interest rates, falling house prices amid external global shocks. Markets are likely to focus on upcoming job market data, which will provide further clues on the economic outlook. (james.glynn@wsj.com; @JamesGlynnWSJ)
